culpritSource.quote: Inspector Megure reviews all of the suspects movements before the murder. Kogoro continues to try to blame Higo for the murder, so Conan tranquilizes him and reveals that the culprit is Akimichi Yamada. Yamada killed Asuka because Asuka had discovered that he was a fraud who wanted to expand the business with the extra money he'd saved by buying cheap wine that he served as expensive vintage to the restaurant clients.

motive.zhHans: Yamada 杀害了 Asuka，因为 Asuka 发现他是个骗子，想用买廉价葡萄酒省下的钱来扩展生意，并把廉价酒当作高档年份酒端给餐厅的客人。其他暴露 Yamada 侍酒师身份造假的线索包括：Yamada 没有嗅闻他端给 Higo 和 Yoko 的那瓶酒的软木塞，而真正的侍酒师总会这样做，以检查酒是否被制造软木塞所用化学物质的残留污染；以及在卫生间里发现的香烟是同一品牌，却有两种不同的吸法，证明它们是由两个不同的人抽的。Yamada 因此试图隐瞒自己抽烟的习惯（这对侍酒师是禁忌，因为该职业在很大程度上依赖于完好的味觉），把自己的烟蒂和 Konoe 用过的烟蒂混在一起。
motive.en: Yamada killed Asuka because Asuka had discovered that he was a fraud who wanted to expand the business with the extra money he'd saved by buying cheap wine that he served as expensive vintage to the restaurant clients. Other hints to Yamada's faked profession as a sommelier were provided when: Yamada did not sniff the cork of the wine bottle he had served Higo and Yoko, something a real sommelier always does in order to find out whether the wine has been spoiled by the residue of the chemicals used in making the bottle corks, and the fact that the cigarettes found in the toilet were of the same brand, but smoked in two different ways, proving that they were consumed by two different people. Yamada thus attempted to conceal his habit of smoking (a taboo for a sommelier, since his profession heavily depends on an unspoiled sense of taste) by mixing his own cigarette stubs with the ones used by Konoe.

method.zhHans: Yamada 在第二次搜寻时下到储藏室，杀死了 Asuka，随后用 Higo 和 Asuka 的手机发消息，将 Asuka 引诱到僻静处实施谋杀。接着 Yamada 用吸尘器、真空压缩袋、Asuka 的衣服以及他侍酒师刀具上的开瓶器，假装 Asuka 在案发时以及员工搜寻他时显然还活着（从而为自己建立不在场证明）：他先从真空袋中抽出所有空气，再用刀上的开瓶器刺破袋子，使空气涌入并使袋子鼓起，在毯子下方瞬间形成一个假人。为了提供这个手法的证据，Ai 从厨房的垃圾桶里拿到了 Higo 扔掉的手机和真空袋，上面布满了 Yamada 的指纹。其他暴露 Yamada 侍酒师身份造假的线索包括：Yamada 没有嗅闻他端给 Higo 和 Yoko 的那瓶酒的软木塞，而真正的侍酒师总会这样做，以检查酒是否被制造软木塞所用化学物质的残留污染；以及在卫生间里发现的香烟是同一品牌，却有两种不同的吸法，证明它们是由两个不同的人抽的。Yamada 因此试图隐瞒自己抽烟的习惯（这对侍酒师是禁忌，因为该职业在很大程度上依赖于完好的味觉），把自己的烟蒂和 Konoe 用过的烟蒂混在一起。
method.en: Yamada killed Asuka during the second search when he went down to the storage room, then used Higo's and Asuka's phones to send a message to lure Asuka to a secluded spot for the murder. Using a vacuum cleaner, a vacuum compression bag, Asuka's clothes, and the corkscrew from his sommelier's knife, Yamada then pretended that Asuka was apparently still alive at the time of the murder and during his employees' search for him (thus establishing his alibi): By first sucking out all the air from the vacuum bag, then puncturing the bag with the corkscrew from his knife, caused the air to rush in and inflate the bag, creating an instant dummy beneath the blankets. To provide the evidence for that trick, Ai secures Higo's discarded phone and the vacuum bags from the kitchen's waste bin, which are riddled with Yamada's fingerprints. Other hints to Yamada's faked profession as a sommelier were provided when: Yamada did not sniff the cork of the wine bottle he had served Higo and Yoko, something a real sommelier always does in order to find out whether the wine has been spoiled by the residue of the chemicals used in making the bottle corks, and the fact that the cigarettes found in the toilet were of the same brand, but smoked in two different ways, proving that they were consumed by two different people. Yamada thus attempted to conceal his habit of smoking (a taboo for a sommelier, since his profession heavily depends on an unspoiled sense of taste) by mixing his own cigarette stubs with the ones used by Konoe.
